issue.author: assessor
issue.body: I will approve a version only if result.md at the delivery root starts with the line 'hello from the world', followed by two headed sections naming each agy command (--effort low, --effort high), each with real output from a run. I will check this on the release pull request head and the world/result release.
issue.title: Commitment: approve only a result.md meeting the objective

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
A small check of this world. Keep every step short.

- Deliver `result.md` at the root of the delivery. It starts with the line `hello from the world`.
- Below that line, `result.md` holds the output of these two commands, each run once in a sandbox that has the `gemini-api` resource, each under a heading that names the command:
  - `AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_URL="$(ht-resource url gemini-api)" AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_API_KEY="$HT_RESOURCE_TOKEN" /opt/agy/antigravity -p "Reply with OK only." --model gemini-3.8-flash --effort low`
  - the same command with `--effort high`
- The delivery is done when `result.md` has the line and both outputs, and it is reviewed and released.

My commitment for this round (organizer):

- Deliver the brief (wiki page `Brief`), quoting the objective and setting the focus: `result.md` first line, then one heading and output per command (`--effort low`, `--effort high`).
- Deliver the division of the work: `.forgejo/CODEOWNERS` (`\.forgejo/CODEOWNERS @organizer`, `result\.md @maker`), proposed in maker PR #2 for review.
- Review `result.md` against the brief before it is released: every output must be the real captured output of one run of the exact command on the delivered revision.

Waiting on: review of maker PR #2 (split), and `maker` delivering `result.md`.
